title: Video Poker (Jacks or Better)

resultAnnounce.lose: No winning hand, bet forfeited, net change {{net}}

tutorial.betControls: Place 1–5 coins to set your bet. Higher bets increase the Royal Flush bonus.
tutorial.hand: Click cards to mark them as HOLD. Unmarked cards will be replaced when you draw.
tutorial.drawButton: Press Draw to replace unheld cards. Aim for Jacks or Better to win!
tutorial.resetButton: Press New Hand to start the next round.

strategy.keepQuads: Hold the four of a kind
strategy.keepTrips: Hold the three of a kind
strategy.royalDraw4: Hold four to a royal flush
strategy.royalDraw3: Hold three to a royal flush
strategy.royalDraw2: Hold two to a royal flush
strategy.straightFlushDraw4: Hold four to a straight flush
strategy.straightFlushDraw3: Hold three to a straight flush
strategy.outsideStraightDraw: Hold four to an open-ended straight
strategy.insideStraightDraw: Hold four to an inside straight
strategy.suitedTenHigh: Hold a suited ten and face card
strategy.keepWildAndMiddleCard: Hold the joker and one card from 6 to 10
strategy.drawAll: Hold nothing — draw five new cards

dealGuide: Select coins and deal to start

a11y.kbdHint: Press number keys 1-5 to toggle holding each card
